title: Profit and loss
pageHelp: Company account classifications, with the ledger rows behind every total.
coverage: Imported posted ledger entries only. This does not certify that the company books are complete.
empty: Profit and loss needs posted general-ledger entries and confirmed account classifications. Ledger import is not available yet; bank cash movements cannot establish profit.
partial: This is a partial report. Review excluded entries and ledger gaps before using its totals.
error: Profit and loss could not be loaded. Check the period and try again.
accountHelp: Confirm how each company account appears in profit and loss. Subledgers group the supporting detail.
saveError: The classification was not saved. Try again.
readOnly: An owner or accountant can confirm these classifications.
noAccounts: No general-ledger accounts have been imported.
sourceHelp: Subledger families group accounts; they do not certify a control-account reconciliation.
periodHelp: Use recent, all, a year (2026), quarter (2026-Q1), month (2026-03), or range (2026-01..2026-03).

exclusions.CURRENCY: Entries with missing or different currency: {{count}}
exclusions.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Entries without an eligible source document: {{count}}

gaps.MISSING_JOURNAL_ID: Some entries have no journal ID.
gaps.UNBALANCED_JOURNAL: Some imported journals do not balance.
